title: [rebuild of #19389] [finding] `datasource` is a 14th `allowRuntimeCreate: true` type with zero live `runtimeTypes` declarations — invisible to #19275's census because its registry entry is the only MULTI-LINE one
body:
⭐ **REBUILD of card #19389**, whose original is unreachable. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917) on 2026-09-21, under the same instruction that rebuilt #19384 as #19541 and #19474 as #19542: the original was filed by the banned `os-sam` account.

⛔ The original is **not** deleted and ⛔ nothing here overrules it. Measured at this act:

| path | reading |
| --- | --- |
| `GET …/issues/19389` | **404** Not Found |
| `PATCH …/issues/19389` | **404** — it cannot be edited, labelled or closed |
| `…/issues/19389/comments` · `/timeline` | **200** — its three comments and its history still resolve |
| control, a card this seat filed | `…/issues/19491` **200** |

### ⇒ Why this one had to be rebuilt even though nothing is in flight on it

The original sat in `pm:queue` at **`priority:p1`** and **no seat can take it**: `label-write` needs `GET /issues/{n}` to read the current label set, so claiming it — which means writing `pm:dispatched` and an assignee — exits **5** before it writes anything. A p1 that cannot be claimed is a p1 that silently never happens. ⛔ That is worse than a visible gap, so the card is rebuilt rather than left to rot in a queue that still lists it.

⚠️ The original's own `Blocked-by` leg and its triage grading are reproduced verbatim below and are ⛔ **not** re-judged here. Its labels were `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:spec` · `pm:queue`; this rebuild carries the same, and ⛔ a re-grade is triage's, not this seat's.

⚠️ One reading in the original body is now **stale through no fault of its own**: it points at the group-A/group-C wiring work as the place `datasource`'s classification would be decided. That work landed as PR #19517 against card #19542 and it **held `skill` out**, so group A is three types, not four. ⛔ This does not change `datasource`'s question — it is still 「group A wiring or group D retirement」 — but whoever takes this card should read #19542 and the hand-off card **#19527** before assuming the group-A shape.

---

## The original card, reproduced verbatim below, ⛔ not rewritten

分诊重测与定级:2026-09-20T16:57Z
⏹ ~~Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#19275~~ — **RELEASED 2026-09-21T02:04Z**. 解锁条件是转换评论 `5751631858` 给出的那一行 —— `Unlock-action: re-check #19389 when label needs-user-decision absent` —— 而 #19275 的 `needs-user-decision` 已在裁决 `5754204885` 同笔摘除，卡现读为 `closed`/`completed`，标签 `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:spec`。双查的另一腿也过：该转换评论（18:06:47Z）之后本卡 timeline 只有两条来自 open **issue** 的 cross-reference（#9857 巡查锚、#18549 座位贴），**无更新的 merged PR** ⇒ ⛔ 不拒。⚠️ `datasource` **不在裁决覆盖的十型之内**，所以它的组归属（A 类接线 / D 类退役）是**派发的第一项读数**，⛔ 不得默认折进 #19474 或 #19475。

Filed by the `domain:spec` **seat 3** execution seat (seat post #18883, `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`), from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the read-only measurement round on #19275. ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no `priority:*`, ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

## The defect

**`datasource` declares `allowRuntimeCreate: true` and is named by no live `runtimeTypes` declaration** — the same shape #19275 measured on 13 types and #19143 measured on `dataset`. It is a **14th** member of that population, and #19275 never listed it.

⭐ The reason it was missed is the interesting half: **its registry entry is the only multi-line one**, so every single-line reader of `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` is blind to it.

## ⏱️ Measured — `origin/main` `a88a97332fc90cb04e9dbae2d4e2f5aa56cab708`, 2026-09-20T15:28Z, re-taken by this seat (⛔ not adopted from the dev's report)

**Leg 1 — the entry, `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:929-947`:**

```ts
  {
    type: 'datasource',
    label: 'Datasource',
    filePatterns: ['**/*.datasource.ts', '**/*.datasource.yml'],
    supportsOverlay: false,
    allowOrgOverride: false,
    allowRuntimeCreate: true,
    …
  },
```

**The shape control, same file, same instrument** — every neighbour is one line:

```ts
:724  { type: 'object', label: 'Object', …, allowRuntimeCreate: true, …, domain: 'data' },
:949  { type: 'external_catalog', label: 'External Catalog', …, allowRuntimeCreate: true, …, domain: 'system' },
```

⇒ a reader keyed on `type:` and `allowRuntimeCreate:` appearing **on one line** sees `object` and `external_catalog` and ⛔ cannot see `datasource`. That is the whole mechanism.

**Leg 2 — live `runtimeTypes` declarations in `packages/lint/src` (non-test, comment lines excluded):**

| | |
|---|---|
| declarations naming `datasource` | **0** ⇐ the finding |
| ⭐ lit control, same grep, same corpus: declarations naming `'object'` | **13** |
| dark control, same file: `stack.zzznotacollection` | **0** |

⇒ the zero is lit on both sides and is a real absence, ⛔ not a dead instrument.

## Why it is its own card and not an amendment to #19275

#19275 was split by triage (`5750391429`) so that the card holds **the measurement of 10 named types** and nothing else; its dispatch order carries 「只量、不改、逐类型分开报」 as a hard bound. `datasource` is outside those ten and outside the `app` / `position` pair that #19370 rules on. Folding it into either would widen a bounded round after the fact.

⚠️ And it changes a number the board is carrying. #19275's face says 「13 个(#19272 落地后剩 12)」. Re-measured today: `dataset` **left** the set for real (PR #19272 merged 2026-09-20T10:13:03Z) and `datasource` **entered as an instrument correction** — it was already there on the card's own ref `fb33767cf1`. ⇒ the count reads **13 both times while membership differs by two**. That is exactly what a bare count hides, and it is why #19275's own body says 「打印全体、⛔ 不给计数」.

## What this card does NOT ask for

⛔ No disposition of `datasource` — whether its declaration should be retired or a rule built is the same fork #19370 holds for `app` / `position`, and this card ⛔ does not answer it, prejudge it or widen that card. ⛔ No claim that any rule would **fire**: leg 2 is a source-level reading and no rule was executed.

⚠️ Successor duty for whoever re-takes this census: read the registry with a **multi-line-aware** parser, or the next re-take reproduces this same blind spot. The single-line assumption was measured true for `runtimeTypes:` arrays (`grep -rn -A1 "runtimeTypes:\s*\[\s*$"` reads empty, lit control passing) and is measured **false** for the registry itself — two surfaces, two answers, and #19275's instrument note only covered the first.
